title: Discovery of Novel Inhibitors of a Critical Brain Enzyme Using a Homology Model and a Deep Convolutional Neural Network.
summary: The primary abstract identifies AtomNet and reports five low-micromolar inhibitors of a rare-disease enzyme. This supports hit discovery, not treatment efficacy.
organization: Numerion Labs (United States); University of Toledo
